evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: A conceptual distinction asserted as self-evident logic, performing rational persuasion through definitional contrast rather than authority or appeal.

evidence.quote: The substrate is a commodity; the perspective is the asset you keep.

observations.why: Supplies and controls the framing of facts — commodity vs. asset — to shape the listener's reasoning, blending informational control with rational-persuasion argument structure.

mints.title: the substrate is a commodity; the perspective is the asset you keep
mints.frame: Is the speaker reclassifying what is fungible versus what is proprietary to shift where value accrues, independent of the specific subject matter?
